turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Ms. Hale. I have about twenty minutes, and I've read the procedure. Why did my son find out about a zero from his phone?
I didn't come for thanks. You gave my son a zero. Walk me through how that happened.
I'm sorry? I have a client call in twenty minutes. Owen. The zero. How did it get into the gradebook?
Hale, I'm not here to discuss me. Fifteen minutes. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
